options.name: dialog_DirtyRefluxStation
options.title: 脏桶回流窗口
options.onDialogOpened: const extraData = this.getExtraData();//获取外部带入数据对象（打开弹窗时通过打开弹窗事件带入的参数）const deviceName = extraData.deviceName;const deviceNo = extraData.deviceNo;this.getWidgetRef('txtCNo',false).setValue(deviceNo);this.getWidgetRef('txtCName',false).setValue(deviceName);var singlar = this.getFormRef().globalDsv.signalR;//取消监听singlar.off("PublicDirtyRefluxBucketReachMessage");//监听事件singlar.on("PublicDirtyRefluxBucketReachMessage", (para, msg) => {  if(para != null && para != undefined && para.deviceNo == deviceNo)  {    const now = new Date();    const formattedDate = now.toLocaleString();	  	var oldStr = this.getWidgetRef('CMessage',false).getValue();  	var newStr = "收到了组桶工位桶到事件,桶号："+para.containerNo+'，时间：'+ formattedDate;  	var message = "";  	if(oldStr == "" || oldStr == undefined || oldStr == null)  	{  		message = newStr;  	}  	else  	{  		message = oldStr + "\n" + newStr;  	}    this.getWidgetRef('CMessage',false).setValue(message);	  this.getWidgetRef('CContainerNo',false).setValue(para.containerNo);  }});

options.name: dialog_PackOverturnStation
options.title: 包装翻倒操作窗口
options.onDialogOpened: const extraData = this.getExtraData();//获取外部带入数据对象（打开弹窗时通过打开弹窗事件带入的参数）const deviceName = extraData.deviceName;const deviceNo = extraData.deviceNo;this.getWidgetRef('txtPNo',false).setValue(deviceNo);this.getWidgetRef('txtPName',false).setValue(deviceName);var singlar = this.getFormRef().globalDsv.signalR;//取消监听singlar.off("PublicPackerOverturnBucketReachMessage");singlar.off("PublicPackerOverturnCompleteMessage");//监听事件singlar.on("PublicPackerOverturnBucketReachMessage", (para, msg) => {  if(para != null && para != undefined && para.deviceNo == deviceNo)  {    const now = new Date();    const formattedDate = now.toLocaleString();	  	var oldStr = this.getWidgetRef('txtPMessage',false).getValue();  	var newStr = "包装翻倒工位"+para.deviceNo+"收到桶到事件,桶号："+para.containerNo+'，时间：'+ formattedDate;  	var message = "";  	if(oldStr == "" || oldStr == undefined || oldStr == null)  	{  		message = newStr;  	}  	else  	{  		message = oldStr + "\n" + newStr;  	}    this.getWidgetRef('txtPMessage',false).setValue(message);	  this.getWidgetRef('overturnContainerNo',false).setValue(para.containerNo);  }});singlar.on("PublicPackerOverturnCompleteMessage", (para, msg) => {  if(para != null && para != undefined && para.deviceNo == deviceNo)  {    const now = new Date();    const formattedDate = now.toLocaleString();	  	var oldStr = this.getWidgetRef('txtPMessage',false).getValue();  	var newStr = "包装翻倒工位"+para.deviceNo+"收到翻倒完成事件,时间："+ formattedDate;  	var message = "";  	if(oldStr == "" || oldStr == undefined || oldStr == null)  	{  		message = newStr;  	}  	else  	{  		message = oldStr + "\n" + newStr;  	}  	    this.getWidgetRef('txtPMessage',false).setValue(message);  }});
